verdict: Organic presence holding; paid channels offline and pipeline blockers need resolution.
narrative: Across all three locations — Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals — your combined 373 Google Business Profile actions this period represent the entirety of measurable marketing activity, as paid advertising carries zero spend and zero leads across all 28 days. GBP engagement is softening heading into this week: Advance Grinding dropped 50% week-over-week, O'Hare fell 16%, and Forte stalled to zero actions over the last three days, a trend we're watching closely. The root cause for the organic dip points to search visibility gaps that are gated behind an overdue SEO root-cause fix, which is now being pushed to resolution along with the outstanding contact and CRM reconciliation work. Once those blockers clear — targeted for completion by end of September and October — outreach sequences, CRM pipeline data, and paid channel activity can all come online in sequence.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining across all three locations over the last 7 days, with search clicks also trending down — organic visibility is softening.
watch_item.fix: The SEO root-cause fix and site reindexing work are being finalized this period, and profile optimization for the two underperforming O'Hare locations is underway to recover call volume.
